intent_en: To demonstrate that vaccine effectiveness against hospitalization declines for older adults over time.
previous_intent: To illustrate the decline in estimated vaccine effectiveness against hospitalization for older adults across major vaccine brands from May to August.
narration_support: There are certain groups in which we do see a reduction in protection against even some of those more severe outcomes. And those are specifically older people.
chart_support: Line charts showing estimated vaccine effectiveness against hospitalization for the 65+ age group across three vaccines (Pfizer, Moderna, Johnson & Johnson) from May to August, displaying a downward trend.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states there is a reduction in protection for older people against severe outcomes. The chart supports this by visualizing a decrease in vaccine effectiveness against hospitalization for the 65+ demographic from May to August for all three major vaccines.
